CA.rationale: Content (red) and a processing/origin label are explicitly co-reported for the same candidate referent.

COD.rationale: A content listing (red), an explicit origin/status field, and organizational description co-occur for the same current referent.

A.rationale: A processing/origin label (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly tied to the same candidate content entry (red), indicating a content-processing relation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify color-labeled cell sets (red) tied to named referents and times.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status fields are provided alongside content listings, distinguishing content identity from representation status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The report describes spatial orientation and names current vs conditional candidate peaks, and lists structured cell-membership patterns, which state presentation/organization/access.
